summary.text: Mike McFall is the Democratic state representative for Michigan House District 14 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia says he has worked in the nonprofit sector and served on the Hazel Park City Council.

paragraphs.text: Mike McFall was born in Flint, Michigan, and earned a B.S. in community development and public administration from Central Michigan University in 2014.

His career experience includes working as a membership services and philanthropy associate with the Williams Syndrome Association, a corporate recruiter with ABM | Healthcare, and an associate director of communications and engagement with the Robert Toigo Foundation.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, McFall said he grew up in a blue-collar, union family outside Flint and worked his way through college.
McFall served on the Hazel Park City Council, according to Ballotpedia.
In the 2022 survey he listed mental health care, public education from preschool through college and technical training, and voting rights among his policy priorities.
